scope: Every tracked .lean blob in exact branch commit, including archived and third-party copies; not untracked drafts.
limits: Lexical advisory scan, not a Lean parser/typechecker or proof validation.
Only theorem/lemma/example with := and recognized line-leading commands; equation-style declarations are reported unsupported.
No macro expansion, namespace resolution, notation elaboration, typeclass dependency inference or exact lexical-shadow semantics.
Token use may be qualified name or local shadow; categories are candidates requiring source review, not confirmed errors.
Same-line scoped commands such as include hp in lemma ... are not recognized as declarations and may be omitted without an unsupported record.
Scoped variable (...) in is not modeled: its binders may leak into subsequent lexical candidates.
Qualified names such as Nat.x can match an unrelated section variable x.

This scan detects textual proof-only references, not hidden premises in elaborated types; automatic section/typeclass dependency capture requires hosted elaborated-type versus source-syntax inspection.
Passed scan cannot certify absence of omitted binders.
